claim: Under a fixed authenticated Pool program binary and the Solana owner/atomicity rules, every reachable persisted canonical pair-forest lane is either its strict genesis image or the byte-exact output of an authenticated Pool transition.
assumptions: The Pool program binary and program ID are authenticated before use.
Only the owning Solana program can mutate account data.
A failed transaction rolls back account creation, CPI effects and program writes atomically.
Program upgrade or arbitrary genesis injection of an already Pool-owned lane account is outside the fixed-binary reachable-state claim.

baseCase.freshness: canonical lane PDA is fresh System-owned/empty or exact-size rent-exempt Pool-owned zero data
baseCase.image: strict canonical pair-domain genesis lane image

inductiveCases.authentication: canonical Pool owner/PDA/master/lane identity, exact wire/account cardinality, capacity, canonical fields and inactive frontier, retained current history root, exact SPL custody delta
inductiveCases.successor: checked pair-domain occupied/empty append; strict-equivalent canonical byte image

inductiveCases.authentication: canonical Pool owner/PDA/master/lane/checkpoint, Registry release/profile/program selection, proof-account identity, verifier return program and exact ASR8 afterstate binding
inductiveCases.successor: verifier-authenticated canonical next lane encoded byte-exactly

omittedChecks: source root reconstruction from the already persisted active frontier
successor root reconstruction during re-encoding after the checked append already produced it
preservedChecks: canonical account length, magic, versions and format binding
Pool ownership and canonical lane/master PDA identity
retained current history-page PDA, header, fill and root equality
fresh and rollover page identity/zero/rent checks
exact SPL custody delta before persistence
